# Sodium ΔNa Uncertainty Calculator

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/sodium_change
Purpose: Program to evaluate how likely two sodium values represent a real change
Status: No manuscript version is expected. Code and teaching text are repository-authored unless otherwise noted.

## Human-Readable Entry Points
- `README.md` is the primary human-facing overview.
- `llms.txt` is a compact machine-readable index and should not replace the README.
